name: Miran gas field export pipeline (to Bazian power plant)
monitor_reason: Add-threshold leg (c) fails for the PIPELINE: no pipeline-specific concrete step exists (no MOU, FEED, EPC award, tender, permit, or FID for any Miran-Bazian line). The only firm commitment is the May 2025 binding term sheet + PSC for the FIELD (Miran Energy JV = HKN Energy + ONEX Group with the KRG), and the field itself is still in an 18-20 month exploration/appraisal phase (50-70 MMcf/d initial). Leg (b) is also weak: the pipeline endpoints have never been stated as a pipeline project - the line is inferred from MEES (Aug 2025) saying gas from the fast-tracked 100 MMcf/d processing plant 'will feed the nearby Bazian power plant', plus a Miran Energy recruitment posting listing a 'sour gas trunk line and sweet gas delivery line and connection to the Bazian Power Plant' as engineering scope. Neither is a project milestone, and it is not even confirmed a standalone evacuation pipeline of material length is required. Sponsor (leg a) is clear, but one leg alone = monitor, not new_row.
researcher_notes: Match-to-existing re-checked independently against all 54 Iraq gas rows in discovery_context.json: no Miran- or Bazian-destination pipeline exists (nearest Kurdistan gas lines P6823 Khormor-Pirdawood, P4047 Khormor-Erbil, P7457 Semel-Duhok are distinct) - not matched_existing. Field-level facts corroborated by multiple independent outlets and confirmed high-tier: MEES 15 Aug 2025 (Miran partners fast-tracking a 100 MMcf/d gas processing plant, first gas targeted 2H 2027, gas to feed the nearby Bazian power plant); Kurdistan24 19 May 2025 (HKN Energy + ONEX Group launch Miran Energy JV, binding term sheet with KRG for phased development of the ~8 tcf Miran field, Sulaymaniyah gov., domestic-supply focus, PSC expected shortly); OilPrice (18-20 month exploration/assessment, 50-70 MMcf/d projected). All four cited URLs re-verified this session via scripts/url_verifier.py (kurdistan24 contains 'Miran Energy'; MEES, OilPrice, and the iqjscout recruitment posting each contain 'Bazian'). CONFLATION GUARD: the widely reported dedicated ~40 km Chemchemal-to-Bazian-industrial-area pipeline is a SEPARATE candidate (vetted under slug chemchemal-bazian-gas), and a completed 16 km / 20-inch line to Bazian PP is a Khor Mor / Qaiwan Group project (orient-pipeline.com) - neither is the Miran line; they must not be used to manufacture Miran endpoints, length, or diameter. No source (English or in-country coverage through 2026) states a Miran-Bazian pipeline route, length, diameter, capacity, or pipeline contract - all pipeline specifics are inferred, so no values are staged. entity_lookup (gas): Miran Energy, HKN Energy, and ONEX Group are all new entities (fuzzy hits were false positives) - stage on promotion. Confidence: field-level facts high/independent; the pipeline itself low/inferred -> MONITOR. Re-check triggers: Miran PSC signature followed by a pipeline FEED/EPC/tender or permit, or a confirmed standalone Miran->Bazian evacuation line with stated endpoints/specs. Excluded URLs (failed verification this session): onexholding.com post (HTTP 404); iraq-businessnews.com JV story (HTTP 401).
